title: Writing down the Hot Five tunes and which ones were played live
summary: Armstrong says New Orleans musicians needed no written parts and that only the popular tunes were played regularly.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Did you have to take these down then off the records later to-
Well, not with New Orleans musicians, but I mean if I had to do it nowadays I had to arrange it, you know, for the youngsters. You know, but they have the same parts, you know.
Did you play these tunes at the time, which made these records you were working with? Not all of them, not all of them.
The usual ones, the popular ones we played, but a lot of things we did just got lost.
